# FNB-ETAF Java and test-code guidance

- Preserve public method names, existing Gherkin bindings, and boolean/string return contracts unless an approved requirement explicitly changes them.
- Keep framework modules focused. Use existing package ownership: ui, api, db, mobile, performance, ui_performance, reporting, softassert, hooks, and utils.
- Do not launch browsers directly from ordinary step definitions. Standard browser/context creation remains the responsibility of BrowserFactory and Hooks.
- Preserve the detailed UI failure path. A failure must retain the original Playwright or assertion cause rather than replacing it with a generic mismatch.
- Catch exceptions only where the framework can add useful context or evidence. Preserve the original cause when rethrowing.
- Use existing configuration accessors instead of hard-coding browser settings, timeouts, report settings, or environment values.
- Add narrow local tests for a changed behavior. Avoid broad refactoring unless explicitly requested.
